I'm Carroll Vance, a Machine Learning Engineer III at Medical Metrics Inc.,
based in Houston's Texas Medical Center. I write mostly about Julia: machine
learning with Lux and Reactant, performance, and building production services.

## Projects

- [EnzymeAD/ReactantNitro.jl](https://github.com/EnzymeAD/ReactantNitro.jl): Reactant-first training for Lux models
- [EnzymeAD/ReactantServer.jl](https://github.com/EnzymeAD/ReactantServer.jl): production inference server for Reactant-compiled models over gRPC
- [JuliaIO/gRPCClient.jl](https://github.com/JuliaIO/gRPCClient.jl): Julia gRPC client
- [JuliaIO/gRPCServer.jl](https://github.com/JuliaIO/gRPCServer.jl): Julia gRPC server
- [Luximm.jl](https://github.com/csvance/Luximm.jl): Lux.jl image models
- [DocumenterLandingPage.jl](https://github.com/csvance/DocumenterLandingPage.jl): VitePress-style landing page for Documenter.jl
